title: release-kit releases.json, schema version 1
description: Every release of a repo as data, newest first. Written by release-kit's npm run release and backfill. Every key is always present; unknown values are null. A change that would break a reader gets a new schemaVersion and a new schema file; version 1 only ever gains optional keys.

schemaVersion.description: The format's version. Readers should refuse a version they don't know.

repository.description: The GitHub repo, owner/repo, or null when it isn't on GitHub.

tag.description: The git tag: v and the version.

date.description: The release's day, as CHANGELOG.md shows it (in .release.json timeZone).

time.description: When the release was cut (for a backfilled release, when its tag was made), ISO 8601 in UTC, or null.

url.description: The GitHub Release page, or null when the repo isn't on GitHub.

previous.description: The release tag this one follows, or null for the first.

summary.description: The releaser's lead line (npm run release -- --summary), or null.

breaking.description: True when any note is a breaking change.

notes.description: The user-facing changes, in section order (breaking, new, fixed, safer, faster, reverted), commit order within a section. Empty for a maintenance release.

source.description: release: written by npm run release (or the train) as the release was cut. backfill: reconstructed later from the commits between tags by release-kit backfill.

unattributed.description: Commits in the release that backfill couldn't read as Conventional Commits, so the notes may leave out changes. 0 for every release cut by the kit.

section.description: Where the note belongs, whatever the repo's headings call it: breaking (Breaking changes), new (New / Features), fixed (Fixed / Fixes), safer (Safer / Security), faster (Faster / Performance), reverted (Reverted / Reverts).

type.description: The Conventional Commit type: feat, fix, perf, security or revert, or any type for a breaking change.

text.description: The note as written for users: the commit's Release-note line, else its subject, capitalized, without the trailing (#12). It may hold inline Markdown such as `code`.

breaking.description: True for a breaking change (! or a BREAKING CHANGE footer).

pr.description: The pull request number, or null for a commit without one.

prUrl.description: The pull request's URL, or null.

commit.description: The full commit SHA, or null.
